name: nf-tax-penalties-remission
description: Assess selected Australian administrative tax penalties affecting Norfolk Island taxpayers in 2026. Use for late returns, false statements, tax shortfalls, default assessments, agent safe harbour, voluntary disclosure and remission requests. Includes primary legislation, current authority guidance and fictional boundary components. Requires the actual obligation, due date, statement, correct liability, agent evidence, entity classification and notice history. Preserves applicable workflow outputs and holds unresolved facts, specialist regimes and actual submissions for professional review. This draft does not complete the compliance or country pack.
